name: Personalizer
intro: Personalizer is a drag and drop canvas for building web pages and creatives, then filling each one with a contact's own name, company and offer.

features.element-palette: The element palette on the left adds headings, text, images, buttons, forms and videos to your canvas with a single click.
features.canvas-size: Pick a canvas size preset, like landing page, email, social post or story, or type your own width and height to match where the page will live.
features.tokens: Token chips insert placeholders such as first name or company into the selected element. One design can then speak to every contact.
features.active-contact-and-preview: Choose an Active Contact, then press Preview Personalized to see the page exactly as that person would see it.
features.properties-panel: Select any element and the Properties panel lets you fine tune its position, size, text, colors and fonts.
features.personalization-hub: The Personalization hub holds your client profiles and asset library, and can discover images from a website, so your brand material is always at hand.
features.export-html: Export HTML opens your personalized page as a standalone page, ready to share or host wherever you like.

outro: That's Personalizer. Design once, personalize for everyone, and save your canvas so you can pick up right where you left off.
